name: Ridgeline Denver office
description: Sample: dc01's scan reaches this office over the site VPN. On day 2 the attacker copies a Cobalt Strike beacon to den-fs01, which calls the C2 through the office's own internet line. Later the CyberStrike AI FortiGate campaign tries passwords on the office's SSL-VPN; the second factor stops it.

name: Ridgeline Tampa office
description: Sample: only dc01's scan reaches this office from the Gootloader intrusion. On day 2 the CyberStrike AI FortiGate campaign tries passwords on the office's SSL-VPN, logs in with one that works, scans the office and copies files from tpa-fs01.

name: Corvane HQ
description: Sample: an AI agent (Cairn, CL-STA-1238 in Unit 42's report) maps the public servers, brute-forces the partner portal, pulls user and email lists, and comes back with an API token. The CyberStrike AI campaign's scanners probe the public servers too.

name: Corvane Phoenix plant
description: Sample: the agent logs into the site VPN with a leaked group password, scans the plant network and reads the file server. The CyberStrike AI campaign's scanners probe the VPN gateway.

name: Corvane Austin design center
description: Sample: VPN login with the leaked group password, SSH to the build server, source code pulled from GitLab, tools fetched from the staging server. A user also lands on two Gootloader sites (blocked), and the CyberStrike AI campaign's scanners probe the VPN gateway.

name: Corvane Dresden service center
description: Sample: the leaked group password no longer works here; only failed VPN logins. Analyzed with the IOC feed from before Unit 42's report, so only Compare's re-hunt finds the egress address. The CyberStrike AI campaign's scanners probe the VPN gateway.
